Government AB (pre-law track) at Harvard University

What Harvard University asks of applicants to Government AB (pre-law track) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Harvard University courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT or ACT required
  • Only in exceptional cases, when those tests are not accessible, can AP, IB, GCSE/A-Level or national leaving exam results (actual or predicted) meet the requirement
  • No score cutoffs; scores may be self-reported

Harvard’s requirements pages are undated and apply to all Harvard College applicants (requirements are the same for domestic and international applicants), whatever the intended concentration.

Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: Application Requirements · Harvard: International Applicants
English language
  • No English proficiency exam required for first-year applicants; scores may be submitted if you wish
  • TOEFL, IELTS and Duolingo cannot meet the SAT/ACT requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: International Applicants · Harvard: International Applicants
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test; the only required test is the SAT or ACT, for all first-year applicants.

Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: First-Year Applicants
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Harvard recommends (not requires) four years of English, four years of a single foreign language, at least two (preferably three) years of history, four years of mathematics, and four years of science (physics, chemistry and biology, preferably one at an advanced level). No specific math course is required and calculus is not a requirement for admission; students intending to study engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics or statistics may benefit from taking calculus. These recommendations apply to all applicants.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: Guide to Preparing for College · Harvard: Application Requirements
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Schools teaching the A-level curriculum are expected to send predicted grades. A-level results may be submitted as additional academic credentials; in exceptional cases when the SAT/ACT is not accessible, A-level results (actual or predicted) can meet the testing requirement.

Harvard states no A-Level grade or IB points requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: Application Requirements · Harvard: Application Requirements
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Schools teaching the IB curriculum are expected to send predicted grades. IB scores may be submitted as additional academic credentials; in exceptional cases when the SAT/ACT is not accessible, IB scores (actual or predicted) can meet the testing requirement.

Harvard states no A-Level grade or IB points requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: Application Requirements · Harvard: Application Requirements
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: AP results may be submitted and self-reported as additional academic credentials (optional)
  • AP results meet the testing requirement only in exceptional cases when the SAT/ACT is not accessible
Verified19 Oct 2026Harvard: Application Requirements · Harvard: Application Requirements
Other requirements
  • Harvard supplement: five required short-answer questions (150 words each)
  • Alumni interview:
    • assigned at Harvard’s discretion based on alumni availability
    • cannot be requested
    • the application is complete without one
  • Supplementary materials (music, artwork, academic work): entirely optional
